preference_learning.purpose: Use explicit user-selected articles as positive examples for discovery-query expansion and user-interest ranking without turning any source or topic into a quota.
preference_learning.ranking_policy: Similarity to positive samples may increase user_interest_fit, but must never bypass source verification, Published Intelligence Registry canonical URL dedupe, substantive-delta checks, classification, Quality Gate, Full Analysis depth, release gates or category diversity.
derived_content_signals: end-to-end character production breakdown from concept to final asset
practical reproducible material or shader tutorial
production-useful DCC tool or add-on solving a concrete workflow problem
high-value hand-keyed or stylized animation reference
stylized character presentation with strong animation or visual-development reference
artist-authored workflow breakdown with concrete modeling, texturing, rigging, animation or rendering decisions

content_types: high-value stylized animation or visual reference
priority_sources.scan_policy: Actively inspect new and relevant 80 Level articles during normal discovery and targeted refill instead of relying on broad search to surface them incidentally.
priority_sources.admission: Priority-source status affects recall only. Every candidate still requires normal source verification, Registry dedupe, substantive delta, classification, Quality Gate, ranking and Full Analysis evidence.

3d-animation.purpose: Broaden animation intelligence beyond AI motion and tool news to include durable fundamentals and production-ready rigging education.
content_mix: mocap, cleanup, retarget and facial animation
fundamental_animation_topics: weight, balance and center of gravity
walk, run, idle, attack and locomotion cycles
pose readability, silhouette and line of action
source_preferences: official DCC or engine documentation and training
experienced animator or rigging educator tutorials
GDC, SIGGRAPH or reputable training material
3d-animation.tutorial_policy: High-quality foundational tutorials are valid production intelligence even when evergreen or beginner-accessible. Favor reproducible teaching, strong visual explanation and direct production transfer; do not require a new product announcement.
3d-animation.freshness_policy: Fresh material wins when quality is comparable, but strong 1-6 month and evergreen keypose, body-mechanics and rigging tutorials remain eligible.
3d-animation.diversity_guard: Tutorials enrich discovery and ranking but never create a per-topic quota. Avoid allowing one DCC, one educator or one tutorial theme to dominate the category.
